scoring_justification: Agent submits only final steady-state scalars; a full recompute from raw distribution/time traces is infeasible for the verifier. Instead, compare reported values to digitized paper reference with relative tolerance and check the physically required monotonic trend of drift velocity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference swarm parameters for N2 at E/N=10 Td (drift velocity and mean energy) for three ionization degrees.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 3 of the paper (Phys. Rev. A 46, 7889, 1992).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Steady-state plateau values read from the figure and cross-checked with the paper's trend description in Sec. III B 3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported equilibrium values for the specified conditions, obtained from the published plot.

outputs.description: Steady-state drift velocity and mean energy for three ionization degree conditions. The hidden reference values correspond to the paper's equilibrium plateaus at E/N=10 Td.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute the swarm parameters by solving the Boltzmann equation with the specified cross sections and parameters. No Monte Carlo simulation is required.

steps.description: drift_velocity must increase with ionization degree: no_ee < ee_1e-5 < ee_1e-4
